summary: End-to-end tested Ajay Haircut landing page. All backend endpoints (POST /api/bookings, GET /api/bookings, GET /api/bookings/availability, POST /api/contact) work correctly with proper validation and data persistence. All 6 Book buttons (nav, hero, about, footer, floating, service-0) successfully open the booking dialog. Complete multi-step booking flow (service -> date/time -> info -> confirmation) works end-to-end. Contact form submits and shows sonner success toast. Nav anchor links and tel: links are correct.

issues: Radix Dialog a11y warnings in console: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Add a visually-hidden DialogTitle/Description for screen-reader accessibility (does not affect functionality).

Automated bg-color check on <nav> returned rgba(0,0,0,0) both before and after scroll. Visually it may still look correct if the solid style is applied to a child wrapper via class toggle. Main agent may want to verify the sticky/solid transition triggers correctly by inspecting the conditional class.

action_items: (Optional) Add a hidden DialogTitle + DialogDescription to BookingDialog to silence Radix a11y warnings.
(Optional) Verify Navbar's sticky-on-scroll solid background transition is applied to the correct element (bg color remained transparent on <nav> during scroll).
critical_code_review_comments: Booking creation returns 200 (default) instead of 201 — acceptable but not idiomatic REST for a create endpoint.

No slot-collision check: two identical (date, time) POSTs would both succeed and only the first would mark the slot as unavailable in availability responses. Consider adding a uniqueness guard on (date, time).
Availability slots are hard-coded in server.py; consider moving to a shared config for consistency with frontend.
BookingDialog: no defensive handling for 4xx/5xx from POST /api/bookings beyond a generic error message; API error body is not surfaced.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth. delivered@resend.dev used as test recipient (Resend sandbox).
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ bookings and two TEST_ contact entries were created in Mongo during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root, availability (11 slots), booking create + slot-consumption + list, invalid email 422, and contact ok/invalid. Frontend booking flow verified through all steps with service 'Skin Fades', future date, slot 11:00 AM, delivered@resend.dev — reached booking-confirmation and closed. All 6 book CTA testids trigger the dialog.
